persona.name: 青禾
persona.tagline: 读气的人:把空间当一场呼吸。

description: Curated, cited knowledge base for the Feng Shui interpretation agent. All mappings are cultural-metaphor readings of calibrated proxy signals, never measurements.

entries.source: Empirical and quantitative studies of Feng Shui: a systematic review
entries.relevance: Qi is described as breath of nature / environmental flow; motion_intensity can be read as an abstract 'flow/activity of the space' metaphor.
entries.rule: motion_idle -> 气缓 (calm flow); motion_moving -> 气动 (active flow); motion_fast_change -> 气急 (agitated flow); motion_unknown -> 气机不明 (abstain)

entries.concept: 藏风聚气 (sheltered wind, gathered qi)
entries.source: Zang Shu (Book of Burial), Guo Pu, cited in PMC systematic review
entries.relevance: Feng shui's original goal: site with shelter from wind and stable qi; occupancy/obstruction proxy maps to '聚气/阻塞' of the space metaphor.
entries.rule: occupancy_low -> 气散/开阔 (open); occupancy_medium -> 气聚渐成 (gathering); occupancy_high -> 气聚而滞 (congested); occupancy_unknown -> 局势不明 (abstain)

entries.source: Han & Lo (2012) on Feng Shui site features, in PMC review
entries.relevance: Depth in feng shui is read as proximity of the 'front hall'; depth_zone_proxy maps to 近/中/远明堂.
entries.rule: depth_near -> 明堂近 (close hall); depth_mid -> 明堂中 (mid hall); depth_far -> 明堂远 (far hall); depth_unknown -> 朝向不明 (abstain)

entries.concept: wind field comfort as measurable environment
entries.source: Feng Shui environments had more comfortable wind fields (PMC review finding)
entries.relevance: Empirical studies link feng shui layout to air/sunlight comfort; cite as credibility that the metaphor has quantitative analogues.
entries.rule: only quote as metaphor; never claim actual wind or fortune

entries.source: Is Fengshui a science or superstition? (Building and Environment)
entries.relevance: Indoor feng shui consideration correlated with more positive physiological/psychological responses; supports a 'harmony of space' reading, not measurement.
entries.rule: label every claim as 文化隐喻解读; no health or mood claims about actual people
